title: Check and unique constraints
objectives: A CHECK constraint validates each row's invariant. An expression unique index can enforce case-insensitive uniqueness within one tenant.
The nonnegative quantity CHECK rejects impossible inventory and the unique expression index normalizes the SKU comparison by lowercasing before enforcing tenant-scoped uniqueness.
securityBoundary: CHECK treats NULL as unknown; NOT NULL must be explicit. Case-folding behavior may vary with collation and Unicode; define a normalized SKU policy before using this as a production identifier.
